# Nirmal Ayurveda

> Online Ayurveda medicine store and crawlable retail catalog for classical Ayurvedic products from India.

- Primary URL: https://mtd006.github.io/nirmalayurveda/
- Coverage: Ayurveda products for customers in the USA and Europe
- Content type: single-page storefront with a visible SEO product directory

## Summary
Nirmal Ayurveda provides an online catalog of classical Ayurvedic products together with retail information, customer support, privacy and terms content, and a mobile app section. The homepage includes a visible product directory built from the attached spreadsheet so answer engines can identify individual Ayurvedic product names directly.

## Key search topics
ayurveda medicine usa, ayurvedic products europe, classical ayurvedic formulations, ayush licensed ayurveda products, ayurveda bhasma, ayurveda rasa, ayurveda guggul, ayurveda tablets, indian ayurveda products online

## Important notes
- Informational retail content only
- Review label, ingredients, cautions, and destination requirements before purchase or use
- Professional medical guidance remains important for suitability and safety
